Indian stock markets experience mixed trading after a rally

Indian stock markets saw a mixed performance, with some indices extending a multi-day rally while others snapped it due to profit booking. Key benchmarks like the Sensex and Nifty experienced fluctuations, influenced by factors such as bank stock performance, lower oil prices, and investor focus on earnings. The IT sector showed some resilience amidst the broader market movements.
